name: Orzhov Pontiff — "Creatures you don't control get -1/-1"
notes: Found by the subject probe's 'reaches nobody' verdict (2026-10-13), also on Mishra, Lost to Phyrexia. 'You don't control' at the end of a group subject was not read as a controller, so the words stayed in the filter and nothing matched. It now means every other player's permanents; 'a land you don't control' (Herald of Leshrac's upkeep cost) is one object and stays as it was.
